name: Study plan · KRIES Computer Teacher 2026
description: Exam mode for KRIES Computer Teacher recruitment (KEA): Paper 1 (general paper) on 26 Oct and Paper 2 (Computer Teacher) on 27 Oct 2026. An 18-day plan from 10 Oct mapped onto the topics you already have, plus KRIES-only topics (Paper 1: Karnataka land reforms, economy, Panchayat Raj, e-governance, environment, social and cultural history, mental ability, SSLC arithmetic and social science – in Kannada; Paper 2: C Programming and Data Structures topic by topic as in the KRIES syllabus, Java, Computer Graphics). Importing it switches the app to KRIES mode; switch back to GPSTR any time in Profile → Exam mode.

studyPlan.title: KRIES Computer Teacher 2026 study plan
notes: KRIES Paper 1 (100 questions, 100 marks, 2 hours): KEA's general paper – current affairs, general science, geography, social science, history of India and Karnataka, Constitution and public administration, mental ability (SSLC level) and Karnataka's history, land reforms, economy, Panchayat Raj, administration and environment.

KRIES Paper 2 (Computer Teacher) syllabus: C Programming, Data Structures and Operating System in detail; OOPS using C++, DBMS, Software Engineering, System Software, Internet Technology, Basic Java and UNIX, Computer Graphics and Computer Networks by name.
KRIES mode shows only the topics in this plan.
